checked_scope: The epoch/block regret summation, adaptive-action concentration and empirical-versus-current-play distinction.
checks: The truncated doubling epoch has scheduled L<=actual block length ell; its regret <=sqrt(L log(m)/2) sums to less than 4sqrt(ell log(m)). Cauchy-Schwarz across <=K+1 predictable blocks gives the stated reset factor.

Given past and opponents current actions, independent own draws center payoff-sampling error with range length one. Conditional Hoeffding plus player union bound gives sqrt(log(N/alpha)/(2T)); full feedback permits adaptive opponents.

The four-profile matching-pennies cycle gives every fixed and swap deviation equal payoff on complete cycles and regret <=3 on prefixes, while current marginals stay l1-distance one from uniform Nash. This is a low-regret path counterexample, not a universally no-regret algorithm.
